title: Operational local DB + committed ops ledger (#18)
author: Pukujan
body_excerpt:
Closes #18

## Summary
Operational local SQLite (`.ops/ops.db`, gitignored) plus committed `ops/ledger/` projection so agents can see issue logs and discrepancies without treating SQLite as authority.

## Changes
- `src/jev_classifier/ops/` — `OpsStore` schema: `issue_snapshots`, `discrepancy_flags`, `sync_runs`
- `ops/ledger/` — committed `ISSUE_LOG.md`, `DISCREPANCIES.md`, `README.md`, per-item…
